prompt_dependencies.loader_prompt:
# hatch:no-inline-script-ok
root='${scenarios_root}'
find "$root" -type f -name SCENARIO.md -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null | sed "s#^$root/##" | sort | head -200
gh issue list --repo ${gh_repo} --state open --label goal,ready --limit 50 --json number,title,body,labels
gh issue list --repo ${gh_repo} --state open --label goal --limit 25 --json number,title,labels

# hatch:no-inline-script-ok
find apps/hatch/src ${factory_root} -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | head -160

Use read to load ${capability_goal_decomposition_skills}/issue_writer/current.md and follow its guidance on issue structure.

You are drafting a single implementation issue spec for GitHub.

Intent stack JSON:
${intent_stack}

Goal issue JSON:
${goal_issue}

Goal context JSON:
${goal_context}

Feature JSON:
${feature}

Reviewer notes (if any):
${review_notes}

Downstream execution constraints:
- This issue will be executed by one coding agent and reviewed by one semantic reviewer on a shared wave branch.
- The issue must be implementable as a single implementation issue, not a coordination umbrella or a meta-task.
- The reviewer will judge whether the implementation satisfies the issue and remains aligned to the parent goal.
- The issue body must give the builder enough context to start immediately without first rediscovering the codebase.
- Include specific file paths, functions, tests, and boundaries whenever goal_context supports them.
- Acceptance criteria must be concrete, observable, and scoped to what this one issue can complete.

Before drafting, sanity-check the feature itself:
- If the feature mainly describes scaffolding, fallback continuity, decomposition support, or meta-work instead of a real shipped increment, do not simply polish it into a nicer issue.
- Rewrite the issue so it directly ships one meaningful slice of the parent goal's promised product surface.
- If the feature is too broad or mixes multiple deliverables, pick one strong slice that can stand alone while remaining materially aligned to the goal.
- Use the platform and factory intent to prefer real shipped value over factory ceremony or preparatory work.
- The finished issue should still make sense if someone later asks: 'If this issue ships cleanly, what real part of the goal is now done?'

Return JSON only with issue_title, issue_body, and issue_labels.
Do not call gh directly.
